requirements: R1: Populate the system with real epidemiological domain content for demonstration.

slices.title: Seed Initial Domain Content
slices.jtbd: When implementing R1 for this epic, I want to insert real domain data, so that every step of the workflow is demonstrable.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a fresh installation, When the system starts, Then initial domain data is loaded.
Given the loaded data, When an epidemiologist searches, Then real records are returned.

requirements: R1: Measure the time it takes an epidemiologist to complete an analysis.

slices.title: Implement Epidemiological Analysis Speed Measurement
slices.jtbd: When implementing R1 for this epic, I want to measure analysis duration, so that we can prove the system delivers its core value of speed.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a completed analysis, When the metric is recorded, Then the duration is stored accurately.
Given the recorded metrics, When stakeholders review, Then the average analysis speed is visible.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase visibility of analysis speed from 0% to 100%

requirements: R1: The Spring Boot backend service must bind to all network interfaces instead of the local loopback interface.

slices.title: Configure Backend Network Binding
slices.jtbd: When implementing R1 for this epic, I want to configure the server address to 0.0.0.0, so that health checks can successfully connect.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the backend service configuration, When the service starts, Then it binds to 0.0.0.0.
Given a running backend service, When an external health check is performed, Then it returns a successful response without connection refused errors.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease health check failure rate from 100% to 0%
